reviewed_source_basis.conclusion: Canonical Track owner routing loaded; plan consumes current module architecture and Shared contracts.
One platform durable mechanism; owner retains business effect identity and recovery; stale fencing cannot commit and unknown outcomes do not release proof.
Existing assignDefaultFreeTrack owner operation uses typed source intent, one base selection and immutable receipts; no duplicate grants or valid paid downgrade.
WA-R078 requires current binding and durable replay; finite plan does not activate owner product runtime.

Exact fields and row revision required. Current-xid predecessor capability applies only when current revision cap absent. Claim0/reclaim1 predecessor-only caps preserve source-generation comparison; subsequent processing2 uses current work2 and original effect1 cap.
32-worker-ACL profile and exact worker capability fields/revision/fence tokens support the10 missing companion SELECTs and command @row UPDATE; native privilege alone does not supply authorization.

Actual current grant, registered service/job/action/purpose, fresh fence and secret are mandatory. Exact command/effect/Customer/semantic/fingerprint/inbox identity is checked, and original effect fence<=current work fence is permitted.

Worker route scopes every companion row to the bound current job; foreign B row remains hidden despite full foreign capabilities. Existing valid selection forbids duplicate Free INSERT. Reservations have no worker dispatch branch.
Pending-to-committed command UPDATE preserves immutable identity/schema and requires exact changed-field caps; no invented operation or codec needed.
Existing assignDefaultFreeTrackCustomerResult schema/version/body and SHA256(UTF8 PostgreSQL17 jsonb::text) codec support genuine committed command result; terminal command remains immutable.

Actual reclaim increments fence and attempt count once after true expiry. Nonnull relink/terminal mutations reject. Current RuntimeAttempt2 is an ordinary protected audit row, and retained lower-fence committed effect may complete current work.
All deferred effect and Track atomic constraints must pass at actual COMMIT; leased linked checkpoint is source-attainable, and its unproven future runtime is not fabricated by fixture seeding.
Core maps exactly to scoped concurrent/recovery/SELECT/command positives and partial compounds; Free-only selection does not promote paid/full compound claims.

Existing complete group supplies source-owned result schema/body, same-group receipt ID, storage digest, effect, inbox, evidence and ordinary attempt1; planned modifications preserve the established codec and add only genuine pending->committed plus deferred leased checkpoint.

plain_english: The plan uses two real practice job results, then lets a new worker finish one job with its saved result instead of doing it again. It counts exactly three worker attempt notes. This approves the plan for Root to consider; no new test has passed and no database has run.
